description: PLAN-59 (P-8): every acceptance class's payroll months in agency A, by stack, so that no two classes of one stack take one month (PLAN-58's AC-IAM-52a met AC-LVA-57's months). An entry gives absolute months (from..to), a window a class picks one month from (the first with no live regular run, found by creating the run: 201, or the live-period refusal), or a rule computed at run time. A class never takes a month another class's entry gives on its stack; the seed's months are taken by the seed. PLAN-57's own file (lva057-periods.json) stays, and is inside AC-LVA-57's entry. scripts/pay059-validate.ps1 and Pay059PayrollMonthsRegistryTests check that the absolute months overlap nowhere on one stack.

rules.D-PAY-22: The first ended calendar month with no live regular run in agency A, from ACCEPTANCE_PAYROLL_CYCLE_FROM (yyyy-MM; default 12 months before today, Damascus) to the last ended month; skipping the months of lva057-periods.json, the months another class's entry gives on the stack, and any month GET api/attendance/periods/{M} shows closed for anyone in agency A. No month left: AcceptanceGate.RequireData asks for scripts/acceptance-reset.ps1.
rules.current-month: The current month on the service's clock (Asia/Damascus), and a request dated the next month.
rules.current+2: Two consecutive months from the current month + 2 on (a salary change cannot name a month before the current one), skipping every month another entry gives (the seed's included) and every month with a live regular run.

entries.what: a posted regular run of every month (DemoPayrollSeeder.SeedPayrollRunsAsync): live, so a new regular run of these months is refused
one run per status, Correction or FinalSettlement (AcceptancePayrollSeeder.SeedScenarioRunsAsync): outside the live-period index, so D-PAY-22 may take these months; the current+2 rule does not
AC-IAM-53a leaves a frozen regular run of the current month
posts one run of its month and cancels it otherwise
governed by the seed's law-50 version from 2000; no run and no attendance there; both runs cancelled
outside CI (it kills Payroll); proved on the local prod-like stack; its run cancelled
both runs cancelled after the assertions, and its request cancelled
